'''Johan Haneveer Mains And Toys DS''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Johan Haneveer]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds64.htm Mains And Toys], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
